maria: quick final check — draft release notes and internal ops blurb below. change window Thu 22:00–00:30 UTC. need ops + oncall to confirm standby & rollback gate. please reply with signoff or edits.

maria: RELEASE NOTES (draft):
- Feature: Dedicated autoscale burst capacity — early access for select customers
- Fix: kv-cache eviction bug that could cause 500s under sustained concurrency
- Behavior change: default model routing now prefers minor-version pinning; customers can opt into strict version pinning
- Migration: no customer action required; see internal migration doc https://go/release/1.8.2-migration
- Known issue: first-token embeddings warmup may show transient latency spike; mitigated by prefix cache warmup

ryan: LGTM on major bullets. suggestion: soften "no customer action required" -> "no immediate action required" to avoid surprising enterprise customers.

samir: infra check — if we need to roll back, we have a pinback endpoint and deployment lanes ready. adding quick rollback snippet below.

samir: ROLLBACK QUICK-START:
```
# rollback quick
1) Pin traffic: curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"model":"inference-main","version":"1.8.1"}' https://api.internal/models/pin
2) Scale down canary: deploybot scale canary inference-main 0
3) Promote older variant if needed: deploybot promote inference-main v1.8.1
4) Notify customers + escalate per comms runbook
```

deploybot: [deploybot] canary deploy to staging queued by @maria at 2024-11-07T22:05:12Z — job db-7782

elaine: oncall roster — @chris can cover standby from 21:30–00:30 UTC. chris?

chris: I can take standby. will monitor traces + alerts. quick note: set threshold p50>200ms or error_rate>2% for auto-roll triggers.

maria: thanks. ryan, can you add a one-line ops TL;DR for the internal announce so comms can slot it into the blast?

ryan: INTERNAL OPS BLURB (for release note):
"Ops: Standby roster 21:30 UTC. Canary runs 10m. If errors >=2% or p50 latency >200ms for 5m, execute rollback per runbook. Pinback endpoint available for fast remediation."

samir: signing off from infra. I'll keep an eye on autoscaler metrics during canary and have the pinback ready.

elaine: oncall signoff.

chris: adding one small runbook item — fallback to older quantized model (v1.8.1-quant) is enabled; include instruction in runbook.

maria: made the copy tweak ("early access" and softened language). final signoff requested by 19:00 UTC so comms can schedule internal announce.

ryan: signed off for product copy.

samir: infra signed off.

elaine: oncall confirmed.

maria: great — publishing final RN to internal docs and scheduling the announce. thanks everyone :rocket:
